policies.eng_cross+24: daily calibration + recalibrate a qubit on a v0.3 (calibrated) CRITICAL threshold or WARNING forecast alert on its readout probes
policies.eng_any+24: daily calibration + recalibrate on any v0.3 WARNING/CRITICAL alert (drift, threshold, forecast)
policies.eng_cross_only: no schedule; recalibrate on v0.3 threshold or WARNING forecast alerts only
policies.eng_any_only: no schedule; recalibrate on any v0.3 WARNING/CRITICAL alert
policies.cusum+24: daily calibration + recalibrate on a CUSUM alarm (h*, reference = first 10 batches)
policies.cusum_only: no schedule; recalibrate on CUSUM alarms
policies.shewhart+24: daily calibration + recalibrate on a Shewhart alarm (k*)
policies.naive+24: daily calibration + recalibrate when a batch's point estimate exceeds 5%
policies.oracle+24: daily calibration + recalibrate as soon as the true error exceeds 5% (not realisable)
policies.oracle_only: no schedule; recalibrate as soon as the true error exceeds 5% (not realisable)
